_comment: soundmon style guides — proven prompt snippets appended to your description to steer the sound. The analog of pixelmon's styles.json. Combine them: --style impact,metal. Add your own; the key becomes the --style name.

ui.prompt: clean UI sound effect, short, crisp, digital interface, dry, no reverb
ui.negative: music, melody, reverb, long tail, ambience

impact.prompt: heavy impact, punchy transient, strong attack, thud, weighty

whoosh.prompt: fast whoosh, air movement, swoosh, doppler sweep

explosion.prompt: explosion, deep boom, debris, low-end rumble, sharp attack then decay

pickup.prompt: bright pickup sound, cheerful chime, collect item, short and rewarding

footstep.prompt: single footstep, foley, close-mic, dry, natural

door.prompt: door foley, hinge creak, latch click, wood and metal

weapon.prompt: weapon sound, metallic ring, sharp swing, blade

gun.prompt: gunshot, sharp crack, mechanical action, percussive

magic.prompt: magic spell effect, shimmering, ethereal sparkle, rising energy

machine.prompt: mechanical sound, servo, motor whir, industrial, gears

electric.prompt: electric zap, arcing electricity, crackling energy, high voltage

water.prompt: water sound, liquid, splash, flowing, bubbles

fire.prompt: fire sound, crackling flames, roaring burn, embers

glass.prompt: glass sound, sharp shatter, bright shards, brittle ring

ambience.prompt: ambient background loop, atmospheric bed, steady, immersive room tone
ambience.negative: music, melody, sudden transient, sharp attack

horror.prompt: unsettling horror sound design, dissonant, tense drone, eerie

arcade.prompt: retro arcade sound effect, synthesized bleep, square wave, 1980s video game

chiptune.prompt: 8-bit chiptune sound effect, square and noise channel, NES style, synthesized

nature.prompt: natural outdoor sound, organic, field recording, wildlife

vehicle.prompt: vehicle sound, engine, motor load, mechanical rumble

loop.prompt: seamless loop, continuous, no fade, consistent level throughout
loop.negative: fade in, fade out, sudden ending, one-shot

_modifiers: shorthand qualities you can stack onto any of the above

big.prompt: large, cinematic, wide stereo, deep low end

small.prompt: small, delicate, subtle, close and quiet

clean.prompt: clean, high fidelity, well recorded, low noise floor
